comments.body: I'd like to PFI [EIP-8115](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8115), [EIP-8116](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8116), and [EIP-7807](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7807) (have reduced to a non-headliner scope) for the EL side of Hegotá.

I'd like to PFI [EIP-7819](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7819).  There's already [a PR here](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11505) to merge it into the meta EIP.  The reason why 7819 is important is that, since native AA may be shipped in Hegota, it's important that the cost of deploying new smart accounts is low, but deploying accounts will actually get more expensive in Glamsterdam due to [EIP-8037](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8037).  With EIP-7819, new accounts would use simple delegate pointers instead of proxy contracts, vastly reducing the amount of new state that needs to be created, thereby reducing deployment cost.
Hi, I would like to propose [EIP-7906](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7906) for Hegotá.
